notes_for_editor: The Forest Lookouts Charlotte page gives only the name and county, so the original tower has no build date, design, height or staffing in any source checked. The relocation and the 100-foot MC-39 description come from the NHLR entry US 1850 (AR 29), which is also the basis of the existing us-ar-bar-of-ranch record and story. No relocated event was added because no source dates the move. The NHLR page also describes Camp Charlotte, a CCC camp near Charlotte occupied 1935 to 1939; no source ties the camp to the tower, so the story leaves it out. Suggest linking this record to us-ar-bar-of-ranch. The original-site coordinates in the record come from Forest Lookouts and are unverified.
